summary: Expedia Group filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 results and declaring a $0.48/share quarterly dividend ($0.48 annualized, payable June 18, 2026 to holders of record May 28, 2026). Additionally, the board authorized a $5 billion share repurchase program, complementing $700M in buybacks during Q1. The filing highlights strong operational performance (13% gross bookings growth, 15% revenue growth, 83% Adj. EBITDA increase). No advisor or premium is applicable, as this is a capital-return event. The mechanics involve a regular dividend and open-market repurchases. Watch for execution pace of the buyback and any impact on EPS.
